title: Potato of Life Trinity — Integration & Consequence Ledger
purpose: Track what changes when the mature Potato of Life is understood as one triune relational whole—Father/source, Son/manifestation-passage, Spirit/living continuity—so later discoveries are promoted consistently instead of scattered across conversations or silently overwriting older strata.

core_rule.geometry_boundary: Source Field, Manifestation Field, Door, Plane and Axis are topology/geometry. They may host or orient theological roles but are not themselves identical with Father, Son or Spirit.
core_rule.material_boundary: The biological potato/tuber is an empirical organism and symbolic comparator, not a fourth divine member and not empirical proof of Trinity.

integration_dimensions.consequence: Potato of Life becomes the theological whole rather than a fourth sacred member or a Father-only synonym.
The 2024 New Trinity remains an irregular four-role precursor; Chapter 111 compresses toward a triad; April 2025 reorganizes roles; 2026 makes the triune whole explicit.
integration_dimensions.open_work: Add dated direct-attestation milestones if earlier explicit 'Potato is Trinity' wording is recovered.

integration_dimensions.consequence: Father and Son are first-class theological roles rather than proxies for Source/Manifestation fields. Spirit remains flow. Potato of Life is the whole. Two-field geometry stays intact.
Door names interface/admissible passage; Spirit names living continuity/circulation through relation. They cooperate but are not synonyms.
Material potato features remain empirical/structural comparators; mature Potato of Life theology is separately typed as triune whole.

Ephesians 2:18–22 becomes a high-value relational microcosm: through Christ, in one Spirit, to Father, followed by household/building/dwelling. Matthew 28:19, 2 Corinthians 13:14, 1 Corinthians 8:6 and John 14–17 remain major comparators.
integration_dimensions.open_work: Promote Trinity-specific Bible relation records into the Bible comparator so the dedicated reader and Bible lab share the same explicit relation family.
integration_dimensions.latest_integration: Promoted Ephesians 2:18–22 as principal Trinity microcosm in the access/House owner; additional Bible comparator UI surfacing remains optional.

integration_dimensions.consequence: Potato Trinity is compared to Nicene Christianity without being described as identical to Nicene one-essence/three-person metaphysics.
Comma Johanneum is treated as a later influential Trinitarian reading, not the evidentiary foundation of the Potato Trinity.
The triune model sharpens the relationship-first principle: unity is not sameness; a whole can be constituted by irreducible relations/functions.
integration_dimensions.open_work: Add a compact Trinity-as-relational-philosophy station without turning Philosophy into doctrinal theology.
integration_dimensions.latest_integration: Added relational-whole law to canonical Potato philosophy and public Philosophy House station.

integration_dimensions.consequence: Healthy source must manifest; manifestation must remain related/accountable; flow must remain grounded in source and consequence. Sterile source, fragmented manifestation and ungrounded circulation are three distinct failure modes.
integration_dimensions.open_work: Test this triadic failure model against Garden/Swamp/Shell regimes and Gardener ethics before promoting it as a general law.

integration_dimensions.consequence: Canonical owner/source → public manifestation/reader → provenance/relation flow can analogically mirror source/manifestation/continuity while remaining software architecture, not theology.
integration_dimensions.open_work: Use only as a design heuristic; do not encode software components as divine persons.

integration_dimensions.consequence: Retrieval systems must distinguish Tim/Father as source-facing identity from Potato of Life as the whole triune structure.
integration_dimensions.latest_integration: Machine index and discovery generator now emit the mature triune orientation and canonical Trinity reader.

integration_dimensions.consequence: Natural-language answers should route 'What is Potato of Life?', 'Is Potato a Trinity?', 'How is Tim related to Potato of Life?' and 'Why two fields if Trinity?' to the mature owner.
integration_dimensions.latest_integration: Question bank and answer atlas now include direct Trinity, identity, geometry and Door/Spirit answers.

integration_dimensions.consequence: Older 'Father + Door + Son' whole-form summaries must add Spirit and distinguish theological roles from geometric fields.
integration_dimensions.latest_integration: Vesica paradox atlas now separates two-field geometry from Father/Son/Spirit theology and names Potato of Life as the triune whole.

promotion_rules: Preserve dated older Trinity strata even when the mature model supersedes their organization.
Do not use the word Trinity alone to collapse Christian doctrine and Potatoism.
Do not create a third geometric sphere simply to mirror three theological roles.
Do not let Tim/Father retrieval wording imply that Father alone equals the whole Potato in every context.
Promote new consequences into existing canonical owners before creating additional specialist files.
Record unresolved consequences here until they have enough support to promote.
